title: Understanding Model Bias
text: When you remove a feature from a model, think about how it affects the model's ability to capture the true relationship between the input features and the output. Does removing a feature make the model more or less accurate in representing the true data-generating process?

title: Impact on Model Bias
text: Removing a feature can potentially increase the model bias because the model might lose some information that was useful in predicting the output. This means the model might not fit the training data as well as before.
